abil.Adaptability: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.
abil.Aerilate: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abil.Aftermath: Damages the attacker if it contacts the Pokémon with a finishing hit.
abil.Analytic: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.
abil.Anger Point: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.
abil.Anticipation: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon’s dangerous moves.
abil.Aroma Veil: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.
abil.Bad Dreams: Reduces the HP of sleeping opposing Pokémon.
abil.Ball Fetch: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
abil.Battery: Powers up ally Pokémon’s special moves.
abil.Battle Armor: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
abil.Big Pecks: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering effects.
abil.Blaze: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abil.Bulletproof: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.
abil.Chlorophyll: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in harsh sunlight.
abil.Clear Body: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.
abil.Color Change: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.
abil.Competitive: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat sharply when a stat is lowered.
abil.Compound Eyes: The Pokémon’s compound eyes boost its accuracy.
abil.Contrary: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.
abil.Corrosion: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it’s a Steel or Poison type.
abil.Cotton Down: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.
abil.Curious Medicine: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.
abil.Cursed Body: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.
abil.Cute Charm: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.
abil.Damp: Prevents the use of explosive moves, such as Self-Destruct, by dampening its surroundings.
abil.Dancer: When another Pokémon uses a dance move, it can use a dance move following it regardless of its Speed.
abil.Dazzling: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
abil.Defeatist: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.
abil.Defiant: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat sharply when its stats are lowered.
abil.Delta Stream: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.
abil.Desolate Land: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.
abil.Download: Compares an opposing Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.
abil.Drizzle: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.
abil.Drought: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abil.Dry Skin: Restores HP in rain or when hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.
abil.Early Bird: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.
abil.Effect Spore: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on its attacker.
abil.Electric Surge: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abil.Filter: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
abil.Flame Body: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
abil.Flare Boost: Powers up special attacks when the Pokémon is burned.
abil.Flash Fire: Powers up the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves if it’s hit by one.
abil.Flower Gift: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies in harsh sunlight.
abil.Fluffy: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
abil.Forecast: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.
abil.Forewarn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.
abil.Frisk: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon’s held item.
abil.Full Metal Body: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.
abil.Fur Coat: Halves the damage from physical moves.
abil.Gale Wings: Gives priority to Flying-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is full.
abil.Galvanize: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abil.Gluttony: Makes the Pokémon eat a held Berry when its HP drops to half or less, which is sooner than usual.
abil.Gooey: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker’s Speed stat.
abil.Grass Pelt: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.
abil.Grassy Surge: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abil.Guts: It’s so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat.
abil.Harvest: May create another Berry after one is used.
abil.Healer: Sometimes heals an ally’s status condition.
abil.Heatproof: The heatproof body of the Pokémon halves the damage from Fire-type moves that hit it.
abil.Honey Gather: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.
abil.Hustle: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.
abil.Hydration: Heals status conditions if it’s raining.
abil.Hyper Cutter: The Pokémon’s proud of its powerful pincers. They prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.
abil.Ice Body: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in a hailstorm.
abil.Immunity: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.
abil.Imposter: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it’s facing.
abil.Infiltrator: Passes through the opposing Pokémon’s barrier, substitute, and the like and strikes.
abil.Inner Focus: The Pokémon’s intensely focused, and that protects the Pokémon from flinching.
abil.Insomnia: The Pokémon is suffering from insomnia and cannot fall asleep.
abil.Intimidate: The Pokémon intimidates opposing Pokémon upon entering battle, lowering their Attack stat.
abil.Justified: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokémon, for justice.
abil.Keen Eye: Keen eyes prevent other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon’s accuracy.
abil.Klutz: The Pokémon can’t use any held items.
abil.Leaf Guard: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.
abil.Levitate: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
abil.Libero: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.
abil.Lightning Rod: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of being hit by Electric-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.
abil.Limber: Its limber body protects the Pokémon from paralysis.
abil.Liquid Ooze: The oozed liquid has a strong stench, which damages attackers using any draining move.
abil.Magic Bounce: Reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.
abil.Magic Guard: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
abil.Magma Armor: The Pokémon is covered with hot magma, which prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.
abil.Magnet Pull: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from escaping using its magnetic force.
abil.Marvel Scale: The Pokémon’s marvelous scales boost the Defense stat if it has a status condition.
abil.Mega Launcher: Powers up aura and pulse moves.
abil.Merciless: The Pokémon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
abil.Mimicry: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
abil.Minus: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
abil.Mirror Armor: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
abil.Misty Surge: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abil.Mold Breaker: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
abil.Moody: Raises one stat sharply and lowers another every turn.
abil.Motor Drive: Boosts its Speed stat if hit by an Electric-type move instead of taking damage.
abil.Moxie: The Pokémon shows moxie, and that boosts the Attack stat after knocking out any Pokémon.
abil.Multiscale: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
abil.Multitype: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the Plate it holds.
abil.Natural Cure: All status conditions heal when the Pokémon switches out.
abil.Neutralizing Gas: If the Pokémon with Neutralizing Gas is in the battle, the effects of all Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
abil.No Guard: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
abil.Normalize: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abil.Oblivious: The Pokémon is oblivious, and that keeps it from being infatuated or falling for taunts.
abil.Overcoat: Protects the Pokémon from things like sand, hail, and powder.
abil.Overgrow: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abil.Own Tempo: This Pokémon has its own tempo, and that prevents it from becoming confused.
abil.Pastel Veil: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.
abil.Perish Body: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
abil.Pickpocket: Steals an item from an attacker that made direct contact.
abil.Pickup: The Pokémon may pick up the item an opposing Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
abil.Pixilate: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abil.Plus: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
abil.Poison Heal: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned instead of losing HP.
abil.Poison Point: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
abil.Poison Touch: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
abil.Power of Alchemy: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
abil.Power Spot: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
abil.Prankster: Gives priority to a status move.
abil.Pressure: By putting pressure on the opposing Pokémon, it raises their PP usage.
abil.Primordial Sea: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.
abil.Propeller Tail: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
abil.Protean: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.
abil.Psychic Surge: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abil.Punk Rock: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
abil.Pure Power: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.
abil.Queenly Majesty: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
abil.Quick Draw: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
abil.Quick Feet: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.
abil.Rain Dish: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
abil.Rattled: Dark-, Ghost-, and Bug-type moves scare the Pokémon and boost its Speed stat.
abil.Reckless: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
abil.Refrigerate: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abil.Regenerator: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.
abil.Ripen: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
abil.Rivalry: Becomes competitive and deals more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but deals less to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
abil.Rock Head: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
abil.Rough Skin: This Pokémon inflicts damage with its rough skin to the attacker on contact.
abil.Run Away: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.
abil.Sand Force: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
abil.Sand Rush: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a sandstorm.
abil.Sand Spit: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.
abil.Sand Stream: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
abil.Sand Veil: Boosts the Pokémon’s evasiveness in a sandstorm.
abil.Sap Sipper: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move instead of taking damage.
abil.Scrappy: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.
abil.Screen Cleaner: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
abil.Serene Grace: Boosts the likelihood of additional effects occurring when attacking.
abil.Shadow Tag: This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon’s shadow to prevent it from escaping.
abil.Shed Skin: The Pokémon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.
abil.Sheer Force: Removes additional effects to increase the power of moves when attacking.
abil.Shell Armor: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
abil.Shield Dust: This Pokémon’s dust blocks the additional effects of attacks taken.
abil.Simple: The stat changes the Pokémon receives are doubled.
abil.Skill Link: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.
abil.Slow Start: For five turns, the Pokémon’s Attack and Speed stats are halved.
abil.Slush Rush: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a hailstorm.
abil.Sniper: Powers up moves if they become critical hits when attacking.
abil.Snow Warning: The Pokémon summons a hailstorm when it enters a battle.
abil.Solar Power: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat in harsh sunlight, but HP decreases every turn.
abil.Solid Rock: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
abil.Soundproof: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.
abil.Speed Boost: Its Speed stat is boosted every turn.
abil.Stall: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.
abil.Static: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity, so contact with it may cause paralysis.
abil.Steadfast: The Pokémon’s determination boosts the Speed stat each time the Pokémon flinches.
abil.Steely Spirit: Powers up ally Pokémon’s Steel-type moves.
abil.Stench: By releasing stench when attacking, this Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
abil.Sticky Hold: Items held by the Pokémon are stuck fast and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
abil.Storm Drain: Draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of being hit by Water-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.
abil.Strong Jaw: The Pokémon’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
abil.Sturdy: It cannot be knocked out with one hit. One-hit KO moves cannot knock it out, either.
abil.Suction Cups: This Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot to negate all moves and items that force switching out.
abil.Super Luck: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.
abil.Surge Surfer: Doubles the Pokémon’s Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
abil.Swarm: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abil.Sweet Veil: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.
abil.Swift Swim: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in rain.
abil.Symbiosis: The Pokémon passes its item to an ally that has used up an item.
abil.Synchronize: The attacker will receive the same status condition if it inflicts a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokémon.
abil.Tangled Feet: Raises evasiveness if the Pokémon is confused.
abil.Tangling Hair: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker’s Speed stat.
abil.Technician: Powers up the Pokémon’s weaker moves.
abil.Telepathy: Anticipates an ally’s attack and dodges it.
abil.Thick Fat: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
abil.Tinted Lens: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.
abil.Torrent: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.
abil.Tough Claws: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
abil.Toxic Boost: Powers up physical attacks when the Pokémon is poisoned.
abil.Trace: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon’s Ability.
abil.Triage: Gives priority to a healing move.
abil.Truant: The Pokémon can’t use a move if it had used a move on the previous turn.
abil.Unaware: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target Pokémon’s stat changes.
abil.Unburden: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon’s held item is used or lost.
abil.Unnerve: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
abil.Vital Spirit: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
abil.Volt Absorb: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move instead of taking damage.
abil.Water Absorb: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move instead of taking damage.
abil.Water Veil: The Pokémon is covered with a water veil, which prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
abil.Weak Armor: Physical attacks to the Pokémon lower its Defense stat but sharply raise its Speed stat.
abil.White Smoke: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
abil.Wimp Out: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
abil.Wonder Guard: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
abil.Wonder Skin: Makes status moves more likely to miss.

mons.dex: For some time after its birth, it grows by taking nourishment from the seed on its back.
mons.name: Bulbasaur

mons.dex: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
mons.name: Ivysaur

mons.dex: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
mons.name: Venusaur

mons.dex: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If the Pokémon is healthy, its tail burns intensely.
mons.name: Charmander

mons.dex: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
mons.name: Charmeleon

mons.dex: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
mons.name: Charizard

mons.dex: It hides in its shell to protect itself, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
mons.name: Squirtle

mons.dex: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
mons.name: Wartortle

mons.dex: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
mons.name: Blastoise

mons.dex: It releases a stench from its red antennae to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
mons.name: Caterpie

mons.dex: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. The Pokémon quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
mons.name: Metapod

mons.dex: It loves the nectar of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
mons.name: Butterfree

mons.dex: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
mons.name: Weedle

mons.dex: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
mons.name: Kakuna

mons.dex: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
mons.name: Beedrill

mons.dex: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
mons.name: Pidgey

mons.dex: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
mons.name: Pidgeotto

mons.dex: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
mons.name: Pidgeot

mons.dex: It’s cautious in the extreme, and its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
mons.name: Rattata

mons.dex: It whittles down its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder block walls.
mons.name: Raticate

mons.dex: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
mons.name: Spearow

mons.dex: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
mons.name: Fearow

mons.dex: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
mons.name: Ekans

mons.dex: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
mons.name: Arbok

mons.dex: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks.
mons.name: Pikachu

mons.dex: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.
mons.name: Raichu

mons.dex: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
mons.name: Sandshrew

mons.dex: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
mons.name: Sandslash

mons.dex: While this Pokémon does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the venom it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.
mons.name: Nidoran♀

mons.dex: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow more slowly than Nidorino’s.
mons.name: Nidorina

mons.dex: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
mons.name: Nidoqueen

mons.dex: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
mons.name: Nidoran♂

mons.dex: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes venom upon impact.
mons.name: Nidorino

mons.dex: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
mons.name: Nidoking

mons.dex: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Clefairy

mons.dex: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
mons.name: Clefable

mons.dex: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
mons.name: Vulpix

mons.dex: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. The Pokémon is said to live for 1,000 years.
mons.name: Ninetales

mons.dex: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
mons.name: Jigglypuff

mons.dex: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
mons.name: Wigglytuff

mons.dex: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Zubat

mons.dex: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.
mons.name: Golbat

mons.dex: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
mons.name: Oddish

mons.dex: The nectar it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious that it can make noses curl from more than a mile away.
mons.name: Gloom

mons.dex: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
mons.name: Vileplume

mons.dex: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
mons.name: Paras

mons.dex: Parasect is controlled by a mushroom that has grown larger than its host’s body. The Pokémon scatters poisonous spores.
mons.name: Parasect

mons.dex: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
mons.name: Venonat

mons.dex: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
mons.name: Venomoth

mons.dex: This Pokémon lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
mons.name: Diglett

mons.dex: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
mons.name: Dugtrio

mons.dex: It is nocturnal by nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter as brightly as the shiny object.
mons.name: Meowth

mons.dex: It is a very haughty Pokémon. Among fans of Persian, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
mons.name: Persian

mons.dex: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.
mons.name: Psyduck

mons.dex: This Pokémon lives in lakes. It swims faster than any world-class swimmer.
mons.name: Golduck

mons.dex: It lives in treetop colonies. If one member of the group becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
mons.name: Mankey

mons.dex: It becomes angry if it sees an opponent’s eyes and gets angrier if the opponent runs. Even after it beats the opponent, it is still angry.
mons.name: Primeape

mons.dex: It is a Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
mons.name: Growlithe

mons.dex: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
mons.name: Arcanine

mons.dex: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
mons.name: Poliwag

mons.dex: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
mons.name: Poliwhirl

mons.dex: With its extremely tough muscles, it could keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
mons.name: Poliwrath

mons.dex: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
mons.name: Abra

mons.dex: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
mons.name: Kadabra

mons.dex: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.
mons.name: Alakazam

mons.dex: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
mons.name: Machop

mons.dex: Machoke’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.
mons.name: Machoke

mons.dex: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.
mons.name: Machamp

mons.dex: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
mons.name: Bellsprout

mons.dex: This Pokémon has the appearance of a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
mons.name: Weepinbell

mons.dex: In its mouth, it pools a fragrant nectar-like fluid. The fluid is really an acid that dissolves anything.
mons.name: Victreebel

mons.dex: Its body is mostly composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
mons.name: Tentacool

mons.dex: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.
mons.name: Tentacruel

mons.dex: Many live on mountain trails and remain half-buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Geodude

mons.dex: Graveler make their homes on sheer cliff faces that have numerous holes in them.
mons.name: Graveler

mons.dex: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulder-like body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.
mons.name: Golem

mons.dex: About an hour after birth, Ponyta’s fiery mane and tail grow out, giving the Pokémon an impressive appearance.
mons.name: Ponyta

mons.dex: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.
mons.name: Rapidash

mons.dex: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
mons.name: Slowpoke

mons.dex: Though usually dim-witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
mons.name: Slowbro

mons.dex: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

edges: Level Up in Magnetic Field / Use Thunder Stone

mons.name: Magnemite

mons.dex: A Magneton is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group of these Pokémon can set off a magnetic storm.

edges: Level Up in Magnetic Field / Use Thunder Stone

mons.name: Magneton

mons.dex: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
mons.name: Farfetch’d

mons.dex: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
mons.name: Doduo

mons.dex: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. This Pokémon runs at nearly 40 mph.
mons.name: Dodrio

mons.dex: This Pokémon lives on icebergs. It uses the sharp point on its head to break up ice as it swims in the sea.
mons.name: Seel

mons.dex: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
mons.name: Dewgong

mons.dex: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

mons.name: Muk

mons.dex: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
mons.name: Shellder

mons.dex: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
mons.name: Cloyster

mons.dex: This Pokémon’s body is 95 percent made up of gases. The Pokémon can be blown away by strong gusts of wind.
mons.name: Gastly

mons.dex: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
mons.name: Haunter

mons.dex: It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

mons.dex: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.
mons.name: Onix

mons.dex: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
mons.name: Drowzee

mons.dex: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
mons.name: Hypno

mons.dex: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are lost in battle.

mons.dex: The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

mons.name: Voltorb

mons.dex: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

mons.dex: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
mons.name: Exeggcute

mons.dex: It is called the Walking Jungle. If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
mons.name: Exeggutor

mons.dex: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
mons.name: Cubone

mons.dex: The bones it uses have been in its possession since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.
mons.name: Marowak

mons.dex: Its legs can stretch to double their length. First-time foes are startled by Hitmonlee’s extensible reach.
mons.name: Hitmonlee

mons.dex: When Hitmonchan twists its arm while throwing a punch, the blow will pulverize even concrete. The Pokémon rests after three minutes of fighting.
mons.name: Hitmonchan

mons.dex: Instead of its hands, it uses its tongue, which can stretch to twice this Pokémon’s height. Lickitung’s sticky saliva grips anything.
mons.name: Lickitung

mons.dex: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell; they are also explosive.
mons.name: Koffing

mons.dex: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
mons.name: Weezing

mons.dex: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.
mons.name: Rhyhorn

mons.dex: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
mons.name: Rhydon

mons.dex: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
mons.name: Chansey

mons.dex: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.
mons.name: Tangela

mons.dex: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.
mons.name: Kangaskhan

mons.dex: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits black ink and flees.
mons.name: Horsea

mons.dex: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
mons.name: Seadra

mons.dex: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.
mons.name: Goldeen

mons.dex: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. The Pokémon defends its eggs with its life.
mons.name: Seaking

mons.dex: If Staryu’s body is damaged, it will regenerate as long as the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
mons.name: Staryu

mons.dex: At the center of its body is a red core that sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
mons.name: Starmie

mons.dex: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.
mons.name: Mr. Mime

mons.dex: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.
mons.name: Scyther

mons.dex: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
mons.name: Jynx

mons.dex: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
mons.name: Electabuzz

mons.dex: It was born in the crater of a volcano. Its body is covered with flames that shimmer like the sun.
mons.name: Magmar

mons.dex: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn apart. What it can’t tear, it tosses far away.
mons.name: Pinsir

mons.dex: Once it takes aim at its prey, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
mons.name: Tauros

mons.dex: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.
mons.name: Magikarp

mons.dex: Once Gyarados appears, its rage never settles until the Pokémon has razed the fields and mountains around it.
mons.name: Gyarados

mons.dex: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
mons.name: Lapras

mons.dex: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

mons.name: Zapdos

mons.dex: It is one of the legendary bird Pokémon. Its appearance is said to indicate the coming of spring.

mons.dex: It is called the Mirage Pokémon because so few have seen it, but its shed skin has been found.
mons.name: Dratini

mons.dex: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
mons.name: Dragonair

mons.dex: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides wrecked ships to shore.
mons.name: Dragonite

mons.name: Mewtwo

mons.dex: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
mons.name: Mew

mons.dex: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the air’s temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.
mons.name: Chikorita

mons.dex: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.
mons.name: Bayleef

mons.dex: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.
mons.name: Meganium

mons.dex: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.
mons.name: Cyndaquil

mons.dex: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns stronger as it prepares to fight.
mons.name: Quilava

mons.dex: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.
mons.name: Typhlosion

mons.dex: It has a habit of biting everything with its well-developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
mons.name: Totodile

mons.dex: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
mons.name: Croconaw

mons.dex: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
mons.name: Feraligatr

mons.dex: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
mons.name: Sentret

mons.dex: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
mons.name: Furret

mons.dex: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.
mons.name: Hoothoot

mons.dex: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.
mons.name: Noctowl

mons.dex: It’s so timid that it can’t move unless it’s with a swarm. It conveys its feelings through scent.
mons.name: Ledyba

mons.dex: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
mons.name: Ledian

mons.dex: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong thread. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
mons.name: Spinarak

mons.dex: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
mons.name: Ariados

mons.dex: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.
mons.name: Crobat

mons.dex: It discharges positive and negative electricity from the tips of its antennae to shock its foes.
mons.name: Chinchou

mons.dex: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed the Deep-Sea Star.
mons.name: Lanturn

mons.dex: The electric sacs on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.
mons.name: Pichu

mons.dex: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.
mons.name: Cleffa

mons.dex: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
mons.name: Igglybuff

mons.dex: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.
mons.name: Togepi

mons.dex: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called joy dust.
mons.name: Togetic

mons.dex: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
mons.name: Natu

mons.dex: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
mons.name: Xatu

mons.dex: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
mons.name: Mareep

mons.dex: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire hair that zaps on impact.
mons.name: Flaaffy

mons.dex: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the light from this Pokémon’s tail.
mons.name: Ampharos

mons.dex: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
mons.name: Bellossom

mons.dex: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow in riverbeds.
mons.name: Marill

mons.dex: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.
mons.name: Azumarill

mons.name: Sudowoodo

mons.dex: They are blown adrift by winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
mons.name: Hoppip

mons.dex: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
mons.name: Skiploom

mons.dex: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
mons.name: Jumpluff

mons.dex: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
mons.name: Aipom

mons.name: Sunkern

mons.name: Sunflora

mons.name: Yanma

mons.dex: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.
mons.name: Wooper

mons.dex: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
mons.name: Quagsire

mons.name: Swinub

mons.dex: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.
mons.name: Piloswine

mons.name: Corsola

mons.dex: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.
mons.name: Remoraid

mons.dex: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

mons.name: Mantine

mons.dex: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

mons.dex: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

mons.dex: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

mons.dex: It attacks by curling up and rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
mons.name: Donphan

mons.name: Porygon2

mons.dex: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
mons.name: Stantler

mons.dex: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
mons.name: Smeargle

mons.dex: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
mons.name: Tyrogue

mons.dex: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by a factor of 10.
mons.name: Hitmontop

mons.dex: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
mons.name: Smoochum

mons.dex: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
mons.name: Elekid

mons.dex: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. It is healthy if it is exhaling yellow flames.
mons.name: Magby

mons.dex: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
mons.name: Miltank

mons.dex: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.
mons.name: Blissey

mons.dex: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
mons.name: Raikou

mons.dex: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
mons.name: Entei

mons.dex: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
mons.name: Suicune

mons.dex: This Pokémon eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
mons.name: Larvitar

mons.dex: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
mons.name: Pupitar

mons.dex: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
mons.name: Tyranitar

mons.dex: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
mons.name: Lugia

mons.dex: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
mons.name: Ho-Oh

mons.dex: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
mons.name: Celebi

mons.dex: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny hooks, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
mons.name: Treecko

mons.dex: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
mons.name: Grovyle

mons.dex: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
mons.name: Sceptile

mons.dex: A fire burns inside it, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
mons.name: Torchic

mons.dex: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
mons.name: Combusken

mons.dex: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
mons.name: Blaziken

mons.dex: Using the fin on its head, Mudkip senses the flow of water to keep track of what’s going on around it. Mudkip has the strength to heft boulders.
mons.name: Mudkip

mons.dex: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
mons.name: Marshtomp

mons.dex: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
mons.name: Swampert

mons.dex: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
mons.name: Poochyena

mons.dex: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
mons.name: Mightyena

mons.dex: It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
mons.name: Zigzagoon

mons.dex: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
mons.name: Linoone

mons.dex: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
mons.name: Wurmple

mons.dex: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.
mons.name: Silcoon

mons.dex: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
mons.name: Beautifly

mons.dex: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.
mons.name: Cascoon

mons.dex: Dustox are nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
mons.name: Dustox

mons.dex: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry for Pokémon that can’t swim.
mons.name: Lotad

mons.dex: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
mons.name: Lombre

mons.dex: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
mons.name: Ludicolo

mons.dex: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon that try to peck at it.
mons.name: Seedot

mons.dex: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in the forest.
mons.name: Nuzleaf

mons.dex: By flapping its leafy fans, it can whip up gusts of 100 feet per second that can level houses.
mons.name: Shiftry

mons.dex: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
mons.name: Taillow

mons.dex: It circles the sky in search of prey and dives sharply to catch its target.
mons.name: Swellow

mons.dex: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.
mons.name: Wingull

mons.dex: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
mons.name: Pelipper

mons.dex: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.
mons.name: Ralts

mons.dex: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.
mons.name: Kirlia

mons.dex: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.
mons.name: Gardevoir

mons.dex: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey in with a sweet scent released from the tip of its head.
mons.name: Surskit

mons.dex: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
mons.name: Masquerain

mons.dex: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over the body if inhaled.
mons.name: Shroomish

mons.dex: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
mons.name: Breloom

mons.dex: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
mons.name: Slakoth

mons.dex: Its heart beats at 10 times its previous rate, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
mons.name: Vigoroth

mons.dex: It is the world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
mons.name: Slaking

mons.dex: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
mons.name: Nincada

mons.dex: Because they move so quickly, they sometimes become unseeable. They congregate around tree sap.
mons.name: Ninjask

mons.dex: It is a discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
mons.name: Shedinja

mons.dex: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
mons.name: Whismur
